Early CKD is listed without essential albuminuria data.
Obesity/metabolic syndrome, anemia, probable NAFLD, OSA, and mood disorder were omitted from the differential.

review_summary: The junior differential captures the core cardiometabolic disorders but under‑estimates their certainty and omits several high‑yield diagnoses and management gaps. Adjusted probabilities have been normalized, confidence scores assigned, and key evidence gaps highlighted. Addressing the missing investigations and therapeutic gaps will improve care.
